policy.selection: pooled Recall@1000, then Recall@100, then lower parameter count
policy.training_examples: first occurrence of each item after strictly earlier user history
policy.same_timestamp: exclude timestamp peers from history and from negative candidates
policy.history_semantics: latest occurrence per item, preserving recency, truncated to max_history
policy.negative_sampling: independent uniform draws with replacement from train-catalog items first seen strictly before the positive timestamp; exclude encoded history and every same-timestamp item; skip examples with no eligible negative
policy.optimizer: Adam lr=0.003 for MLPs, SparseAdam lr=0.003 for embedding tables
policy.device: cpu, one torch thread, deterministic algorithms enabled
policy.history_tower: mean of shared item-id embeddings over recent distinct items, then MLP
policy.item_tower: item-id and as-of-cutoff category embeddings concatenated, then MLP
policy.scoring: L2-normalized user/item vectors with dot product
